subject: Questionnaire kickoff — validation & evidence roadmap for security review
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia King <alicia.king@carepathhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carepathhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Questionnaire kickoff — validation & evidence roadmap for security review

Hi Alicia / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — appreciate you walking us through CarePath's use case. Per our discussion, next step from Redwood is to kick off the vendor security questionnaire and collect the baseline evidence to keep procurement moving. I’m attaching a short Starter Checklist that maps to the items we discussed.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope the asks correctly:
- SOC 2: is CarePath currently SOC 2 Type I or Type II, or in progress? If in progress, what target month for attestation?
- Data classification: will the integration involve PHI or other regulated health identifiers (we heard there may be PHI in test and prod)?
- Residency: any EU data residency/GDPR constraints or is everything US-based?
- Preferred assessment form: do you prefer we complete CAIQ, SIG-lite, or your custom vendor form? We can prefill whichever speeds this up.
- Procurement/legal contact: who should legal send the master services agreement/statement of work to (email/contact)?

If you prefer, we can send a SIG-lite prefill and a network/dataflow diagram template for you to annotate. Proposed timeline from our side: prefill + evidence request within 48 business hours after you confirm preferences, then a short review call with Karthik (security) and Ben (solutions) to walk through any gaps.

Attachments: Redwood_Starter_Checklist.pdf (starter mapping).

Thanks — I’ll hold off on sending the prefill until you confirm SOC2/residency/comments.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alicia King <alicia.king@carepathhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questionnaire kickoff — validation & evidence roadmap for security review

Thanks, Soojin — great summary and yes, please kick this off. Quick answers below to help you scope: 

- SOC 2: We are currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II attestation; fieldwork completes in late December and we expect the final report in mid-February 2027.
- PHI: Yes, production may contain limited PHI (patient identifiers and encounter metadata) — we will need HIPAA BAAs. Test environments contain de-identified data but some datasets are synthetic with small samples of real PHI.
- Residency: Main operations are US-based (US-East), but we have a small EU pilot team — GDPR applies to the EU pilot. For now, primary residency requirement is US.
- Preferred form: Procurement usually accepts either CAIQ or SIG-lite. If Redwood can prefill a SIG-lite, that usually speeds things up on our side.
- Legal/procurement: Loop in our procurement contact Tom Reynolds (cc’d). He handles contracts and PO processing.

Also: please include a high-level network/dataflow diagram template — our infra lead will annotate it.

We’d like the prefill and evidence list by end of week if possible (Friday).

Best,
Alicia King
Head of Partnerships | CarePath Health
alicia.king@carepathhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia King <alicia.king@carepathhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carepathhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Questionnaire kickoff — validation & evidence roadmap for security review

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Alicia’s reply from CarePath. Key points: SOC2 Type II in progress (report expected Feb 2027), production will include limited PHI (BAA required), primary residency US but small EU pilot, they prefer SIG-lite prefill. They’ve requested a network/dataflow template for annotation and want the prefill + evidence list by Friday.

Attachments I’ll include for your review before sending: Redwood_SIG-lite-prefill.xlsx (draft prefill), network-dataflow-carepath.png (template), Redwood_Starter_Checklist.pdf.

Questions for you:
- Karthik: any additional evidence items we should ask for given PHI and HIPAA BAA request? Anything special re: encryption-in-transit/storage keys or key custody that we should flag?
- Ben: can you confirm the runtime/SDKs we should list on the prefill (we discussed hosted API + optional dedicated capacity)? Also any known mitigations for our KV cache and batching that should be documented?

If both of you can review and we turn this around today, I’ll send the prefill to Alicia/Tom and schedule a 30-min technical review for Monday morning (their timezone appears PT).

Thanks — Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia King <alicia.king@carepathhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@carepathhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questionnaire kickoff — validation & evidence roadmap for security review

Appreciate the flag, Soojin — I reviewed Alicia’s notes and the draft prefill. High-level responses and suggested asks below: 

Technical prefill items to confirm:
- Runtime/SDKs: We’ll list Hosted API (production), with Dedicated as an optional reserved capacity path. Include SDKs: python/redwood==2.x, node/redwood-js v1.x.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for in transit; AES-256 at rest. For keys we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) — note that for Dedicated/Private we can integrate customer-managed KMS.
- KV cache/batching: note that KV cache is ephemeral in the serving layer and never written to disk; batching handled by runtime with per-tenant isolation.

Evidence items to request (given PHI/HIPAA):
- BAA: include a copy of our standard BAA (I’ll attach).
- SOC 2: completed report when available; if only in-progress, ask for the Type II timeline and interim controls description.
- Network/dataflow: ask for annotated network-dataflow-carepath.png and list of third-party subprocessors.
- Access control: IAM roles for infra, SSO provider (Okta/SCIM) evidence or screenshots.
- Pen test: most recent internal/external pentest summary and remediation tracker.

Proposed timeline to hit Alicia’s Friday ask:
- Today (Fri): finalize SIG-lite prefill and evidence list (we can mark SOC2 as "Type II in progress — expected Feb 2027").
- Monday: 30-min technical review (09:30 PT suggested) with Karthik and me to answer infra questions.
- After review: send formal evidence request bundle and DocuSign/secure upload link for docs.

I attached: Redwood_BAA_v1.2.pdf (template) and a slightly annotated SIG-lite prefill. Karthik — can you confirm there are no extra items we should request given their PHI note (e.g., specific HSM/KMS proof, EHR integrations)?

If everyone is aligned I’ll send the prefill to Alicia/Tom today and propose Monday 09:30 PT for the review call.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
